cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: Right. Next on the agenda we have traffic and highways. Councillor Thornton.

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: Thank you.

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: Well, we now have the results of the survey carried out last month about traffic and road

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: transport in the town. People were generally satisfied with the state of the roads.

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: There were one or two complaints about potholes which will be addressed, but a

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: significant number of people complained about the increasing number of heavy vehicles

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: using our local roads to avoid traffic elsewhere.

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: We'd expected more complaints by commuters about the reduction in the train service, but

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: it doesn't seem to have affected people too much.

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: The cycle path that runs alongside the river is very well used by both cyclists and

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: pedestrians since the surface was improved last year, but overtaking can be a problem so

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: we're going to add a bit on the side to make it wider.

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: At some stage, we'd like to extend the path so that it goes all the way through the town,

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: but that won't be happening in the immediate future.

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: The plans to have a pedestrian crossing next to the Post Office have unfortunately had to

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: be put on hold for the time being.

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: We'd budgeted for this to be done this financial year, but then there were rumours that

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: the Post Office was going to move, which would have meant there wasn't really a need for

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: a crossing.

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: Now they've confirmed that they're staying where they are, but the Highways Department

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: have told us that it would be dangerous to have a pedestrian crossing where we'd

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: originally planned it as there's a bend in the road there.

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: So that'll need some more thought.

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: On Station Road near the station and level crossing, drivers can face quite long waits if

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: the level crossing's closed, and we've now got signs up requesting them not to leave

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: their engines running at that time.

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: This means pedestrians waiting on the pavement to cross the railway line don't have to

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: breathe in car fumes.

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: We've had some problems with cyclists leaving their bikes chained to the railings outside

cues.speaker: EY
cues.text: the ticket office, but the station has agreed to provide bike racks there.
